title: 4 Verses a Godly Man Memorizes Before Temptation Shows Up
caption:
You can't pull a verse out of your heart that was never put there.

Psalm 119:11. 1 Corinthians 10:13. James 4:7. Matthew 4:4. Pick one, write it on a card, and learn it this week before the moment comes.

Which one are you learning first?
